newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss envoy quits US post over leaked paper.
newsitem.headline: Swiss envoy quits US post over leaked paper.

text.p: Switzerland's ambassador to the United States resigned on Monday after a confidential document he wrote calling for "waging war" against Jewish groups and other vocal critics was leaked to the press, triggering uproar.

In a letter released by the foreign ministry, envoy Carlo Jagmetti said he was quitting because "I no longer find it appropriate to continue my activity as ambassador in this country until the retirement date of July 31, 1997 originally envisioned".

"The leak, the resulting stories in the media and the reaction that followed from persons affected and from the public have created an intolerable situation for me," wrote Jagmetti, 64, adding that he was hurt by charges he was anti-Semitic.
Switzerland's strained ties with Jewish organisations seeking compensation for Holocaust victims worsened with publication of excerpts from the leaked document on Sunday.

Swiss Jewish leaders immediately criticised the comments, which came from a confidential strategy paper Jagmetti sent to Berne last month on how to handle a row over dormant accounts in Swiss banks of Hitler's victims.
Jagmetti said the excerpts were taken out of context and expressed his regret that he had offended anyone.
